2014_spells.fog-cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.
2014_spells.fog-cloud.effectSummary: Create a magical area that affects creatures inside it
2014_spells.fog-cloud.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it; The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
